decision_rule: COMMON_EVALUATION_CONTRACT.json v1.0 decision_rule_L12 unchanged: A2 improves on A0 only if all45 B-vector nRMSE falls by >= 1.0 pp and by more than twice the seed spread; no-harm: seen9 <= +0.5 pp, copper <= +1.0 pp, PhaseAdvance >= 70 group <= +1.0 pp

preregistered_predictions.Q1: steps 41-44 mean snapshot error falls by at least 5 pp from A0 (31.3 percent)
preregistered_predictions.Q2: seen9 B-vector changes by 0.5 pp or less (no dilution, unlike A1)
preregistered_predictions.Q3: interior unused steps change by 1 pp or less
preregistered_predictions.Q4: the PhaseAdvance >= 70 group gap persists (above 5 pp)
preregistered_predictions.use: interpretation aid only, not pass/fail thresholds
